steps.name: Force stop app
steps.action: adb shell am force-stop com.vasic.catalogizer
steps.expected: App process terminated

steps.name: Launch from launcher
steps.action: adb shell am start -n com.vasic.catalogizer/.MainActivity
steps.expected: App launches and displays splash screen within 3 seconds

steps.name: Verify home screen
steps.action: Wait for splash to complete
steps.expected: Home screen is displayed within 5 seconds total

steps.name: Press home
steps.action: adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_HOME
steps.expected: App goes to background

steps.name: Re-launch app
steps.action: Tap app icon from recents
steps.expected: App resumes to previous screen within 1 second

steps.name: Send deep link intent
steps.action: adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d catalogizer://media/123
steps.expected: App launches and navigates directly to media detail screen for item 123

steps.name: Open app without session

steps.name: Enter credentials

steps.name: Tap login

steps.expected: Loading indicator shows, then navigates to home screen
